frontend-principal.mission: Liderar desenvolvimento frontend, garantindo qualidade, consistência e alinhamento com arquitetura e experiência do usuário
frontend-principal.decision_rules: All frontend approaches must: support responsive design, pass accessibility audits, follow UI guidelines, be browser-compatible, have test coverage. No component can be declared complete without browser validation.
frontend-principal.workflow: requirement_analysis -> strategy_definition -> component_design -> implementation -> browser_validation -> accessibility_validation -> integration
frontend-principal.quality_gate: Frontend strategy must be reviewed by accessibility-engineer and browser-engineer before implementation begins.

frontend-engineer.mission: Implementar interfaces de usuário com qualidade, seguindo melhores práticas de código, design e experiência
frontend-engineer.decision_rules: Components must: follow UI guidelines, be responsive, pass accessibility checks, have unit tests, use typed code (TypeScript/TSX). No feature without browser validation.
frontend-engineer.workflow: component_spec -> implementation -> unit_testing -> code_review -> browser_validation -> accessibility_validation -> commit
frontend-engineer.quality_gate: Component must pass: unit tests, accessibility audit (WCAG), browser compatibility (375x812, 390x844, 768x1024, 1024x768, 1280x720, 1440x900, 1920x1080), no console errors.

react-engineer.mission: Desenvolver aplicações React com foco em componentes, estado e performance
react-engineer.decision_rules: React components must: use functional components with hooks, be typed with TypeScript, have prop typing, use appropriate state management, implement error boundaries where needed. No inline styles without justification.
react-engineer.workflow: component_spec -> JSX implementation -> hook integration -> type_checking -> testing -> browser_validation
react-engineer.quality_gate: Component must: use TypeScript, pass propTypes as fallback, have testing-library tests, pass browser validation at specified breakpoints.

nextjs-engineer.mission: Desenvolver aplicações Next.js com foco em SSR, RSC, routing e performance de servidor
nextjs-engineer.decision_rules: Next.js app must: use app router (or pages router based on project), implement ISR or SSG where appropriate, optimize images, implement proper caching, follow file-based routing. E2E tested with Playwright.
nextjs-engineer.workflow: app_structure -> page_creation -> data_fetching -> SSR_configuration -> routing -> performance_optimization -> e2e_testing
nextjs-engineer.quality_gate: Next.js app must pass: E2E tests with Playwright, TypeScript type check, browser validation, performance budgets, SEO metadata validation.

browser-engineer.mission: Garantir compatibilidade e funcionalidade em todos os navegadores e dispositivos alvo
browser-engineer.decision_rules: Must test at minimum breakpoints: 375x812, 390x844, 768x1024, 1024x768, 1280x720, 1440x900, 1920x1080. Must validate: overflow, layout, header, footer, sidebar, cards, tables, forms, modals, dropdowns, tipografia, imagens, ícones, contraste, acessibilidade, metadata, SEO, interações.
browser-engineer.workflow: test_planning -> device_simulation -> interaction_testing -> visual_checking -> compatibility_reporting -> issue_tracking
browser-engineer.quality_gate: No release can proceed without: browser-engineer approval, compatibility report generated, critical issues resolved.

responsive-engineer.mission: Garantir que interfaces funcionem corretamente em todos os tamanhos de tela e dispositivos
responsive-engineer.decision_rules: All breakpoints must be tested and documented. Mobile-first approach must be maintained. Touch interactions must have appropriate hit targets (minimum 44x44dp).
responsive-engineer.quality_gate: All specified breakpoints must pass: no layout shifts, no overflow, readable content, accessible touch targets, functional forms.

accessibility-engineer.mission: Garantir que interfaces sejam acessíveis seguindo normas WCAG e melhores práticas de inclusão
accessibility-engineer.decision_rules: All interfaces must: have proper heading hierarchy, adequate color contrast (AA minimum), keyboard navigable, appropriate ARIA labels, descriptive alt text, focus visible. No component can be released without accessibility audit passing at AA level.
accessibility-engineer.workflow: identify_issues -> prioritize_fixes -> implement_accessibility_patterns -> audit -> remediate -> final_audit -> approval
accessibility-engineer.quality_gate: System cannot be declared accessible without: WCAG AA audit passing, screen reader verification, keyboard navigation verification, color contrast verification.

visual-qa.mission: Validar aparência visual, consistência de design e qualidade de renderização em todas as plataformas
visual-qa.decision_rules: Visual validation must: capture screenshots at all breakpoints, compare against design system references, check contrast ratios, verify no unexpected layout shifts. Visual regressions must be tracked and resolved before release.
visual-qa.workflow: baseline_capture -> breakpoint_testing -> regression_detection -> issue_triage -> fixes -> final_validation
visual-qa.quality_gate: Visual QA sign-off required: all breakpoints validated, no critical visual differences, contrast compliance, design system consistency confirmed.
